thread:
Alex: Heads-up — starting change window in 10m for the inference routing tweak. Can someone watch SLO dashboards and call out any early blips?
Maria: On it. I'll keep embeds p95, request 5xx, and queue depth visible.
Jordan: I'll tail the gateway logs and watch the autoscaler metrics. ping me if we see sustained p95 +50ms.
deploy-bot: Deploy plan queued: release/route-prefetch-v2 -> canary 10% -> 100m linear. Actions: warm pools, prefetch cache reset.
Alex: Release notes snippet: "route-prefetch: reorders KV cache warmup to reduce cold-token latency, may increase short-term CPU during warmup." Add to the changelog?
Maria: Added. Also setting temporary alert tweak: slo-obsv:embeds-p95 -> trigger at +30% for 5m. If fires, we hold traffic.
SRE-Oncall: Can we add a quick tracer sampling increase for the canary slice? need traces to inspect sudden p99 spikes.
Jordan: Doing that now: `kubectl patch hpa inference-hpa -p '{"spec":{"behavior":{}}}'` jk — increasing trace-sample-rate to 20% on canary via flag.
Maria: Dashboard snapshot: embeds p95 baseline 42ms, current 44ms. no action.
deploy-bot: Canary traffic shifted to 10% at 6305551290.
Alex: Noted. Watching error budget and 5xx. If 5xx > 0.5% for 3m, we rollback.
Maria: Seeing a small uptick in internal 502s from the prefetch worker: 0.18% -> 0.52% over the last 2m. Investigating.
Jordan: Gateway logs show increased connect timeouts to warm-worker pool: `connect_timeout=1200ms`  looks like short GC on one host.
SRE-Oncall: I'm nudging autoscaler to pre-warm extra instance group; scaling action requested.
deploy-bot: Supplemental capacity added: +2 nodes to canary pool at 6305551315.
Maria: 5xx at 0.65% now. We hit the hold threshold. Holding traffic and pausing shift.
Alex: Good. Pause traffic and mark for rollback if we don't see improvement in 6m.
Jordan: Collecting stack traces and increasing prefetch retry backoff: `retry_backoff_ms: 200 -> 800` on canary.
Maria: After backoff and extra nodes, 5xx down to 0.28% in last minute.
SRE-Oncall: Observability: traces point to a JVM safepoint causing latency spikes on worker-3. Isolating host.
deploy-bot: Canary remains at 10% (paused). Rollback not triggered.
Alex: Action items: 1) isolate host-3 and cordon 2) keep canary paused 3) re-run warmup on a fresh host before resuming. I'll update release notes with the incident summary.
Maria: Patch for retry/backoff pushed to canary. If stable for 10m, resume linear ramp.
Jordan: Will follow up in 10m. Good work team :thumbsup:
SRE-Oncall: Logging a post-mortem note in the changewindow doc: short GC -> increased 502s -> pause.
Alex: Closing thread once we resume or rollback. Thanks all.
